newsitem.title: USA: Ingersoll-Rand Q1 sales, net, share rise.
newsitem.headline: Ingersoll-Rand Q1 sales, net, share rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: Ingersoll-Rand sold Clark-Hurth Components Group February 14, 1997. The group's 1997 results produced operating income for the first quarter of about $2.7 million. On an after-tax basis, this sale reduced net earnings by about $3.6 million, or $0.03 a share.

For the 1996 Q1, Clark-Hurth generated net earnings of about $0.02 a share; the Process Systems Group (sold in two peices in 1996) generated earnings of about $0.01 a share and the 1996 pulp machinery sale generated a benefit of about $0.26 a share. The 1996 quarter also included charges that cut earnings by about $0.14 a share.
Full company name is Intersoll-Rand Co.
